from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, tempfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, json, os, wave
base=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal/.runtime')
template=Path('/usr/share/lmms/projects/templates/default.mpt')
if not template.is_file():
    print(json.dumps({'error':'LMMS default template not found', 'template':str(template)}))
else:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='phase3-lmms-',dir=str(base)) as tmp:
        root=Path(tmp)
        xml=ET.parse(template)
        track=xml.getroot().find(".//song/trackcontainer/track[@type='0']")
        pattern=ET.SubElement(track,'pattern', {'name':'Ferrari Original','type':'1','pos':'0','len':'192','steps':'16','muted':'0'})
        for key,pos,length in [(57,0,96),(64,96,96)]:
            ET.SubElement(pattern,'note',{'key':str(key),'pos':str(pos),'len':str(length),'vol':'85','pan':'0'})
        src=root/'ferrari-test.mmp';xml.write(src,encoding='utf-8',xml_declaration=True)
        wav=root/'ferrari-test.wav'
        env=os.environ.copy();env['QT_QPA_PLATFORM']='offscreen';env['HOME']=str(root)
        env['XDG_CACHE_HOME']=str(root);env['XDG_CONFIG_HOME']=str(root);env['XDG_DATA_HOME']=str(root)
        try:
            proc=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/lmms','render',str(src),'-o',str(wav),'-f','wav'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=65,env=env)
            out={'returncode':proc.returncode,'stdout_tail':proc.stdout[-500:],'stderr_tail':proc.stderr[-900:],'wav_size':wav.stat().st_size if wav.exists() else 0}
            if wav.is_file():
                with wave.open(str(wav)) as f:out.update({'frames':f.getnframes(),'rate':f.getframerate(),'channels':f.getnchannels()})
            print(json.dumps(out))
        except Exception as e:print(json.dumps({'error':str(e)}))
